[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Logging, Monitoring, and Metrics Architecture (Prometheus/OpenTelemetry) in Kubernetes"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"A robust observability stack is critical for maintaining production-grade Kubernetes workloads. This tutorial covers the modern cloud-native observability pattern utilizing Prometheus for metrics collection and OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing and instrumentation."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Architecture Overview"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Prometheus: Scrapes time-series metrics from Kubernetes pods, services, and cluster components using pull-based architecture."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"OpenTelemetry (OTel): Collects, processes, and exports telemetry data (traces, metrics, and logs) using vendor-neutral APIs and SDKs."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Grafana: Visualizes metrics and traces aggregated from Prometheus and OpenTelemetry backends."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Deploying Prometheus via Helm"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"The standard approach to deploying Prometheus in Kubernetes is through the Prometheus Community Helm chart (kube-prometheus-stack). Run the following commands to install it."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
helm repo update
helm install monitoring prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack --namespace monitoring --create-namespace"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"3. Instrumenting Applications with OpenTelemetry"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"To enable distributed tracing, deploy the OpenTelemetry Collector in your cluster and configure your application SDKs to forward traces to the collector endpoint."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"apiVersion: opentelemetry.io/v1alpha1
kind: OpenTelemetryCollector
metadata:
  name: otel-collector
  namespace: monitoring
spec:
  config: |
    receivers:
      otlp:
        protocols:
          grpc:
          http:
    processors:
      batch:
    exporters:
      logging:
    service:
      pipelines:
        traces:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [batch]
          exporters: [logging]"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"4. Scraping Custom Metrics"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"Prometheus discovers targets using Kubernetes ServiceMonitors. Below is an example of a ServiceMonitor resource that instructs Prometheus to scrape an application exposing metrics on port 8080."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: sample-app-monitor
  namespace: default
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sample-app
  endpoints:
  - port: web
    interval: 15s"},{"order":16,"type":"subheading","text":"5. Validation and Testing"},{"order":17,"type":"paragraph","text":"Verify that Prometheus is successfully scraping your targets by port-forwarding the Prometheus UI and navigating to the targets page."},{"order":18,"type":"code","text":"kubectl port-forward svc/monitoring-kube-prometheus-prometheus 9090:9090 -n monitoring"}]
